connector.name: Ryvo Gateway
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Ryvo Gateway x402, Helius Wallet, and Tokens API market data.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package gateway-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the ryvonetwork account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: RYVO_GATEWAY_BASE_URL
env.description: Optional Ryvo Gateway base URL. Defaults to https://gateway.ryvo.network.

env.name: RYVO_SIGNER_COMMAND
env.description: Executed only by ryvo_gateway_auth_call after an HTTP 402: spawns once with the normalized auth-request JSON on stdin (same shape as ryvo_gateway_prepare_auth). Stdout must be JSON auth output (headers map, or SIWX address+signature). On Windows, npx/npm run under cmd.exe; treat RYVO_SIGNER_COMMAND as untrusted if an attacker controls it.

env.name: RYVO_WALLET_PROFILE
env.description: Optional Ryvo wallet profile hint passed to signer hooks.

env.name: RYVO_PAYMENT_MAX_AMOUNT_USD
env.description: Optional x402 maximum USD amount per request.

env.name: RYVO_PAYMENT_DAILY_LIMIT_USD
env.description: Optional x402 daily authorized spend limit in USD.
